topics.name: Input Module Write Boundary
topics.purpose: Define input-type UserModules as explicit producers that validate and write incoming data into their own declared `#UM.<module_id>` instance boundary.

semantics.target_rule: Input writes to the exact owning UserModule instance data boundary.
semantics.validation_rule: Incoming values are parsed/validated against the owning schema before accepted write.
semantics.event_rule: Accepted input may emit explicit Events after the write according to declared semantics.
semantics.authority_rule: Input reachability does not grant arbitrary writes outside its declared instance boundary.
semantics.failure_rule: Invalid input does not partially mutate accepted instance data.

invariants.rule: Command, input, adapter and view module types have distinct effect boundaries: command is one-shot operation, input writes declared instance data, adapter mounts/translates symbols without owning them, and view is UI-only.

references.purpose: Input data enters governed DWH path at origin.
